none: PAS CAM-C874FC: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows two soldiers and one standard. Mint is uncertain, AD 335-341. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a diademed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: (Chi-rho)//[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.53g, diameter is 14.5mm, thickness is 1.7mm
